source:
@@U02366@@
Hooo! Hooo!
I see I’ve come in the nick of time and
name the lot of you a tawdry mess!
But my special target is Lady Victory up there.
With her white wings spread
she thinks she’s an eagle, no doubt, and
everything she sees she thinks is hers,
people and lands alike.
But bring me face to face
with what is praiseworthy,
and my anger rages.
I bring the high low,
and the low high,
make crooked the straight,
and the straight crooked.
That alone is the source of my health.
That is how I want it on earth.

@@U02368@@
Evil cur! Take this!
This commanding stroke of my pious staff!
Cringe now, writhe and twist!
But what’s this?
The double-masked dwarf crumples
to a hideous shapeless mass!
What is this miracle?
The mass becomes an egg that swells and bursts,
and out of it a pair of twins,
an adder and a bat!
The one crawls off in the dust,
the other flies to the rafters!
They hurry off to meet outside.
I think wouldn’t care to join them.

@@U02370@@
—Hurry! There’s dancing over there!
—No! I wish I was out of here!
—Do you feel the spells they're weaving, that crew?
translation:
@@U02366@@
呼！呼！
我发现我来得正是时候
把你们这些人称为庸俗的烂摊子！
但我的特别目标是上面的胜利女神。
展开她洁白的翅膀
毫无疑问，她认为自己是一只鹰，并且
她认为看到的一切都是她的
人和土地都一样。
但让我面对面
与值得赞扬的事情，
我怒火中烧。
我带来高低，
和低高，
使弯曲变直，
和直的弯的。
仅此一点就是我健康的源泉。
这就是我在地球上想要的样子。

@@U02368@@
邪恶的恶棍！拿着这个！
我虔诚的员工的这一命令！
现在就畏缩、扭动、扭曲！
但这是什么？
双蒙面矮人皱巴巴
变成一团可怕的无形的东西！
这是什么奇迹？
肿块变成了膨胀并破裂的鸡蛋，
其中有一对双胞胎，
一条蝰蛇和一只蝙蝠！
那人在尘土中爬行，
另一个飞到椽子上！
他们赶紧去外面见面。
我想我不会愿意加入他们。

@@U02370@@
——快点！那边正在跳舞！
-不！我希望我能离开这里！
——那些船员们，你感觉到他们正在编织的咒语了吗？
